photos.c: Successful Surrey R.R. Squad. Back l to r: Giles Thrush, Alister Horton, Paul Richley, Richard Addison, Simon Pritchard, Alan Lammas. Front l to r: Michael Blackmore, Andrew North, Paul Gildea, John Neillis, Carl Frater.
[illegible]nning Surrey Youth Road Relay Team; L to R. Richard O'Hara,Andy North,Dave Palmer,John Warren.

It seems like only yesterday when the North Brothers were the mainstay of our Road Relay teams. With ex-National CC Champ-Gerry-, and ex-Inter Counties 3mile winner-Geoff- in the team we always had a head start. And now, with our Road teams putting in much improved performances we once again have ...." The North Brothers" adding to our successes. In this shot the bearded Dave hands over to young Andy in the Southern 12 stage relay.

Above.   Andy North seen here representing Surrey in the Junior Inter Counties broke through last winter to finish a highly respectable 20th in the Junior National C.C.Champs and put his excellent winters background to good use by breaking the Club's long standing Junior 5000m record with a fine 14.55.
